introduction: Michigan offers several health-coverage pathways, including Medicaid and Healthy Michigan Plan. MI Bridges or the current paper application starts the assessment.
description: Michigan offers several health-coverage pathways, including Medicaid and Healthy Michigan Plan. MI Bridges or the current paper application starts the assessment.

sections.who: Each pathway has its own financial and nonfinancial conditions. Age, income, resources and household circumstances affect which coverage may fit.
sections.get: Approved coverage helps with eligible health services. Read the notice for the specific program and any plan-enrollment steps.
sections.docs:
• Household names, birth dates and income information.
  • Identity, residency and requested status records.
  • Additional financial or disability evidence requested for the pathway.
sections.apply:
1. Apply through MI Bridges

    Use MDHHS healthcare application guidance.

  2. Use the current paper form if needed

    DCH-1426 is the listed paper application. The state says older Plan First and Healthy Kids/MIChild applications are obsolete.

  3. Complete verification

    Provide requested records and review each applicant’s decision.
sections.after: Keep contact details and renewal notices current. Confirm the provider accepts the specific coverage.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Current Michigan healthcare application. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Does every pathway have the same rules?
No. MDHHS lists different eligibility requirements for different groups.
DCH-1426, Application for Health Coverage & Help Paying Costs.
Can I reuse an old MIChild application?
The state says DCH-0373 is obsolete and not accepted.
Where can I check the application?
Use MI Bridges and any instructions in the notice.
